protocol: COVID long-stream Setting B, Gaussian likelihood, 143 online weeks

attempts.observation: Two concurrent formal attempts reached about 7.6 GB RSS each after roughly ten minutes, exhausting host memory before either archive was written.
attempts.action: Stopped before host OOM; no predictions.npz was produced.

attempts.observation: A single formal attempt reached about 8.4 GB RSS after roughly ten minutes, with memory continuing to grow as new week-specific JAX executables accumulated.
attempts.action: Stopped under the local memory guard; no predictions.npz was produced.

attempts.observation: The official sparse state-space implementation reached about 15.3 GB RSS during a 39-week diagnostic when supplied a fixed 195-week NaN-masked grid.
attempts.action: Stopped under the local memory guard; no predictions.npz was produced. This experimental adapter mode was removed.

attempts.observation: Each child process reconstructed only legally arrived history before its assigned segment, but the first 16-week child was terminated by the local WSL host before writing predictions.npz. A 4-week probe with deliberately reduced 20 Task-1 iterations and one online inference step was also terminated before producing predictions.
attempts.action: Segment isolation did not make the selected official configuration runnable within the 15 GB local WSL memory limit. No partial segment is reported as a formal result.

reporting_rule: Do not substitute a refit, reduced horizon, reduced inference-step, or synthetic metric for ST-SVGP. It may be rerun on a larger-memory CPU or GPU worker using the same selected capacity and protocol.
